targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(r.response_time_ms) as value FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND r.response_time_ms IS NOT NULL AND p.location IN ($location)

SELECT response_time_ms as value FROM (SELECT response_time_ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY response_time_ms) as row_num, COUNT(*) OVER () as total_count FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND r.response_time_ms IS NOT NULL AND p.location IN ($location)) ranked WHERE row_num = FLOOR(total_count * 0.95) + 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT response_time_ms as value FROM (SELECT response_time_ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY response_time_ms) as row_num, COUNT(*) OVER () as total_count FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND r.response_time_ms IS NOT NULL AND p.location IN ($location)) ranked WHERE row_num = FLOOR(total_count * 0.99) + 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(download_speed_mbps) as value FROM proxies WHERE active = true AND download_speed_mbps IS NOT NULL AND location IN ($location)
SELECT AVG(upload_speed_mbps) as value FROM proxies WHERE active = true AND upload_speed_mbps IS NOT NULL AND location IN ($location)

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(r.timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00')) as time_sec, AVG(r.response_time_ms) as p50, MAX(r.response_time_ms) as p99 FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND p.location IN ($location) AND r.response_time_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY time_sec ORDER BY time_sec

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(r.timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00')) as time_sec, AVG(r.download_speed_mbps) as avg_speed FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND p.location IN ($location) AND r.download_speed_mbps IS NOT NULL GROUP BY time_sec ORDER BY time_sec

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(r.timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00')) as time_sec, AVG(r.upload_speed_mbps) as avg_speed FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND p.location IN ($location) AND r.upload_speed_mbps IS NOT NULL GROUP BY time_sec ORDER BY time_sec

SELECT CASE WHEN r.response_time_ms < 500 THEN '< 500ms' WHEN r.response_time_ms < 1000 THEN '500-1000ms' WHEN r.response_time_ms < 2000 THEN '1000-2000ms' WHEN r.response_time_ms < 5000 THEN '2000-5000ms' ELSE '> 5000ms' END as bucket, COUNT(*) as count FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND r.response_time_ms IS NOT NULL AND p.location IN ($location) GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

SELECT p.name, p.location, AVG(pr.response_time_ms) as avg_latency, p.download_speed_mbps as last_dl, p.upload_speed_mbps as last_ul, COUNT(CASE WHEN pr.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as success_rate FROM proxies p JOIN proxy_requests pr ON p.device_id = pr.proxy_id WHERE $__timeFilter(pr.timestamp) AND p.location IN ($location) GROUP BY p.device_id, p.name, p.location ORDER BY avg_latency ASC LIMIT 20

list.name: location
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT location FROM proxies WHERE location IS NOT NULL
